title: A refined CJ--SS--RR method with a reliable removal approach of spurious Ritz values for the Hermitian eigenvalue problem
summary: Under the hypothesis that the deviations of the desired eigenvectors of the matrix $A$ from the underlying subspace tend to zero, the Ritz vectors may not converge and have poor or little accuracy. This phenomenon is not unusual and particularly occurs when the associated Ritz values are close, which is independent of the eigenvalue distribution of $A$.
